title: The assignment detail reads its own case; the tab stops loading every posting
deviations_from_card: (1) Write set grew by one existing source-guard test: app/api/devcase/lifecycle/[id]/close/close-tenancy.test.ts pinned the OLD expressions (listLifecycles(...currentWorkspace()...) inline; listSubmissions/latestOutcomeByRefs inside postings/route.ts). Re-pinned in the feat commit to the new ones (const ws + listLifecycles(50, ws) + caseIntakeCounts(..., ws); postingsView(..., ws) in both routes; listCasePostings(id, ws); the view's workspace-threaded listSubmissions/latestOutcomeByRefs/inFlightAttemptsByPosting) and it still forbids bare listPostings()/listLifecycles() and a single-argument listSubmissions(). (2) The slice keeps its own row mapper (rowToPosting is private to devcase.ts, which is not in this write set); drift is pinned by a test that deep-equals a listCasePostings row against getPosting(id) + submissionCount. (3) Submissions are still inlined per posting through listSubmissions(p.id, ws) inside the view - bounded by the POSTINGS the caller passes (one case's channels on the new route). (4) useDevTabActions.ts untouched: DevTab passes reloadDetail under its existing loadPostings argument name. (5) Case 5 (postings route shape unchanged) is an invariance pin - the existing route.test.ts, untouched and green before and after - so 5 of 6 were red before the build, not 6.
notes: Auth posture of the new route: requireOperator (identity presence, the same `read` gate as GET /api/devcase/[id]) plus the case-owner check; no requireCapability, so the r08 route-auth-posture rule does not fire - constitution reported 0 blocking (its one note is gate-configuration from sibling commits in the range: ci.yml, rate-limit-contract, run_gated.py). api-reference.md regenerated with api:docs under the lock; only this card's row and the +1 route/+1 handler count were committed. PERF: measured base 11ee55111 + this card's files alone in a git-archive tree -> perf:budget within budget (app/api/devcase/lifecycle/route.ts 228 -> 230 modules / 3097 -> 3106 KB against the 230 / 3117 group ceiling; app/page.tsx 1444 / 9191 KB within 1444 / 9194; new channels route 112 modules / 1762 KB). On the COMMITTED HEAD (342b694f8) lifecycle/route.ts reads 231 modules, 1 over the group ceiling: the third new module is app/_lib/human-scorecard-set.ts from schedule-interview-prep (afb029b67, committed after this card's feat), which reaches the route through the shared hub - combined growth, each card within budget alone. Not raised here (my share fits the existing ceiling); the coordinator's integration settle should name an override for app/api/devcase/lifecycle/route.ts (231) or move that leaf off the hub. HEAD's other perf findings (app/page.tsx, agents/hire-from-need) are not from this card. Full test:unit: 10914/10916 - the 2 failures are the known Windows python-runner process-tree kill and interview-prep/scorecard's rate-limit contract (a sibling's in-flight work at the time; FLAKE-labelled). Dead code: app/features/tools/devcases/devcaseInFlight.ts inFlightByCase is no longer called by the UI (the section reads counts off the row; closeWarning is still used); it stays tested but unused - outside this write set, safe to delete in a follow-up together with its test cases. loop_open: none - this card adds no refusal, gate or stored status; it only puts posting `status` on the typed wire (client Posting.status: 'open' | 'closed'), which slot B consumes. Every surface that read the workspace fold was moved: CaseDetail (+ its Shortlist onChanged and Channels onDone now call reloadDetail), LifecycleSection, DevTab's evaluate_submission/lifecycle reloads, and the publish action's reload. For slot B: CaseDetail's prop is now `casePostings` (already case-scoped, status carried) and its refresh callback is `reloadDetail`; `published = casePostings.length > 0` is left for B to replace.
